telegram.welcome:
Welcome to {{product}}!

I'm your AI cycling coach. I can build training plans, suggest workouts, and track your fitness using {{service}} data.

Commands:
{{plan}} — Generate a training plan
{{workout}} — Get today's workout
{{status}} — Check current fitness, fatigue, and form
{{review}} — Review your last session
{{sync}} — Force-refresh training data from {{service}}
{{version}} — Show current version
{{whatsnew}} — See what changed in the latest version
{{update}} — {{updateDescription}}

Or just chat with me about your training!
